finding_1_preserve_corrected_ranking_log.summary: Preserved Phase 3C.5.2.2.2 ranking logic without unconditional pH rejection. Ordinary Liebig non-compensatory suitability scoring and ranking proceeds across all canonical crops without universal bypass.

finding_2_remove_unsupported_survival_fa.summary: Excised claims in ranking.py that biological survival has failed for all standard arable crops (for sodicity at pH >= 9.0 and acidity at pH < 4.5). Replaced with evidence-backed descriptions of severe physiological and structural constraints.

finding_3_conditional_agronomic_guidance.summary: Maintained high-fidelity Gypsum, Sesbania green manuring, Agricultural Limestone, and KVK guidance as rigorous conditional agronomic advisories when suitability scores fall below the viability threshold (< 40.0).

finding_4_suite_execution_and_external_v.summary: Executed all 62 tests across eight test suites with 100% pass rate both from the project root and an external working directory (/tmp).

finding_5_deterministic_reproducibility.summary: Verified that 50 consecutive runs across diverse pH queries produce 100% bitwise identical output hashes. Zero random variation or ranking instability.
